newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO, UPM SET STEROL TECH J/V.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO, UPM SET STEROL TECH J/V.

text.p: Finnish food and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said in a statement on Friday it had agreed with forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy to set up a joint venture to develop sterol separation technology.

"Raisio and UPM-Kymmene will be transferring all their know-how in sterol separation and manufacture to Sterol Technologies," Raisio said, referring to the new company, of which Raision will own 65 percent and UPM-Kymmene 35 percent.
UPM's Kaukas mill "is a forerunner in sterol separation and a leading wood-sterol producer," Raisio said, adding sterol was separated during the pulp-making process.
"Raisio uses this (sterol) to make stanol ester for its Benecol margarine," it said. Raisio's Benecol margarine helps reduce cholesterol.

The joint venture "plans to market sterol technology know-how in the form of mill design packages to customers in the forest industry," Raisio said, adding its own aim was to "increase and safeguard its long-term supplies of raw sterol." --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
